title: Zesty Light Korean Chicken Wings Bowl
description: A pungent and shattering light polish dish featuring chicken wings, served in a Korean brass bowl. This dish is a perfect combination of spicy and sweet flavors.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together gochujang sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger.
Add the chicken wings to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray.
Arrange the chicken wings on the baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake the chicken wings for 30 minutes or until cooked through.
While the chicken is baking, heat the sesame oil in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped green onions to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute or until fragrant.
To serve, place the cooked chicken wings in a Korean brass bowl and garnish with the green onion mixture.
